title: Microsoft to invest $10 billion in Japan for AI and cyber defence expansion
title_zh: 微软将在日本投资 100 亿美元用于人工智能和网络防御扩张
summary: Microsoft on Friday said it will invest 1.6 trillion yen ($10 ‌billion) in Japan between 2026 and 2029 ‌to expand artificial intelligence infrastructure and strengthen cybersecurity cooperation with ​the government.
summary_zh: 微软周五表示，将在 2026 年至 2029 年间在日本投资 1.6 万亿日元（100 亿美元），以扩大人工智能基础设施并加强与政府的网络安全合作。
